data.exact_reserve_text: During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves. These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate. As a result of these changes, $7.4m of reserves were released in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross reserve release of $29.1 million for prior underwriting years up to 2021. This favorable development was partly driven by a refinement in the managing agent's methodology for estimating claims reserves, including a revision of the actuarial risk margin. Despite impacts from 2022 climate-related natural catastrophes such as Hurricane Ian and Storm Elliot, the 2022 underwriting year is also expected to produce a positive return on capacity, indicating overall favorable development for that prior year.
